intro.title: This is the kitchen screen
intro.p1: It’s the cook’s view — the orders you need to make, in the order to make them. The screen by the grill shows this while the counter uses the orders dashboard.
intro.p2: Cards move across as you tap them, so whoever’s cooking always knows what’s next and nobody has to shout. Everything here is your demo data — have a play.
